sara_support: FYI customer (Acme Corp) on Private saw repeated partial SSE responses + duplicate billing when client reconnects. They report streams cutting mid-event and clients opening a new session (new token) that gets billed.

liam_eng: Which private mode — VPC ingress or on-prem gateway? Any proxy in front?

sara_support: On-prem ingress, corporate proxy (TLS termination + http-inspect). MTU ~1400 on their edge. Token rotation every 60s (short-lived). Happens on long streaming responses (20-45s).

marta_cs: Customer shared a short trace: initial stream id 9876, connection drops at ~17s, client reconnects 1.2s later with new token, charges show two start events in billing. They've reproduced with curl + our JS client.

nikita_infra: I pulled the packet capture they attached. Proxy is chopping the SSE chunk at 1360 bytes boundaries. Client sees an incomplete SSE "data:" line (no terminating "\n\n"), parser decides stream is malformed and closes. Proxy then tears down connection (FIN) instead of waiting. Quick reconnect creates a new billed session.

liam_eng: Oof. So two separate issues colliding: (1) proxy-induced chunk-splitting causes client-side parser to drop connection, (2) short token lifetime means reconnect binds a new billable session. Seems specific to Private/onprem because Dedicated doesn't go through their corp-proxy.

sara_support: Customer logs (redacted):
```
[2026-02-12T14:23:07Z] conn=abcd1234 SSE send: "event:message\ndata:{...long payload...}\n\n"
[2026-02-12T14:23:24Z] proxy split at 1360 bytes -> sent first fragment
[2026-02-12T14:23:24Z] client parser error: "unexpected EOF in data field"
[2026-02-12T14:23:24Z] conn closed by client
[2026-02-12T14:23:25Z] new conn=efgh5678 token rotated
[2026-02-12T14:23:25Z] billing: stream_start count++
```

nikita_infra: Repro steps I used locally (quick):
1) emulate MTU split: `socat -T15 -u TCP-LISTEN:9000,reuseaddr,fork TCP:localhost:9001` then use iptables/clamp-mss or `tc qdisc` to lower MTU on loopback.
2) run a server that emits one large SSE data block (>2000 bytes) without intermediate newlines.
3) use curl `curl --no-buffer -H "Accept: text/event-stream" http://localhost:9000/stream` -> you can see the client abort when the chunk boundary splits the event.

liam_eng: Can you paste the minimal server snippet you used?

nikita_infra: Node example: 
```
const http = require('http');
http.createServer((req,res)=>{
  res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/event-stream','Cache-Control':'no-cache'});
  const big = 'x'.repeat(2500);
  res.write(`data:${big}\n\n`);
});
```
Works when MTU large; fails when split inside `data:` payload.

marta_cs: Customer also shared their client stack: custom electron app with SSE polyfill. It treats any incomplete event as fatal.

liam_eng: Short-term mitigations for customer: 
- Increase proxy idle/stream timeouts or disable http-body inspection if possible.
- Make server emit smaller SSE chunks (split payloads into multiple `data:` events) or insert periodic comment heartbeats `:\n` every 10s so proxy doesn't deem conn idle.
- Increase token lifetime or perform graceful resume with same session id to avoid double-billing on reconnect.

nikita_infra: Long-term platform mitigations we should consider: 
- Server-side: always break large outputs into multiple `data:` frames <= 1200 bytes to avoid common MTU tails.
- Billing: support idempotent stream-session-id header so resumed streams with same session id within Xs are deduped.
- Client SDK: resilient SSE parser tolerant of chunk-splits (buffer incomplete `data:` lines until full event).

liam_eng: Agree. Quick triage: can we add a gateway option for Private to auto-insert 1-byte keepalive comments every 10s? That'd be low-risk.

nikita_infra: Feasible. For onprem customers we can add an optional proxy-side `sse-heartbeat` that injects `:\n` at configurable interval; won't affect Hosted/Dedicated.

deploy-bot: deploy: sse-heartbeat flag added to staging gateway (ref #deploy-554). :rocket:

marta_cs: Next steps for support ticket: 
- Ask customer to enable longer token lifetime (temporary) OR provide SDK update to buffer chunks.
- Offer a staged gateway heartbeat toggle and schedule pilot in their staging env.
- Open billing investigation to dedupe recent duplicate starts for their account (attach server logs).

sara_support: I'll coordinate customer comms and post repro steps + pcap to the ticket. Assigning follow-up to @nikita_infra for heartbeat POC and @liam_eng for SDK parser fix.

liam_eng: I'll prepare a small PR for SSE parser buffering and a test that simulates MTU-splitting.

nikita_infra: I'll have a heartbeat POC in staging by EOD tomorrow and share config.

sara_support: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the customer once we have POC.
